comment: The RPG-7 from the game designer's launcher pack (/Game/Launcher_Animations, 2026-11-09): ONE material + ONE atlas in the pack already (M_Launcher, 4K Albedo / Ao / Metallic(+roughness in A) / Normal), so no re-atlas / re-bake: every part is decimated with the artist's uv islands shielded and the 4K maps are resampled to the 1K BaseColor / Normal / ORM set (Scripts/Pipeline/blender_weapon_rpg7.py + rpg7_textures.py). Frame = the pack's own weapon frame (SK_Weapon_Body_Mesh component space: muzzle +Y, up +Z, the optic on +X = the shooter's left), so the pack's hand socket transform (SK_Mannequin 'Soket_Launcher' on hand_r) mounts it unchanged.
